sourceProjection.basis: Figure 6(d) of the 2024 HBIM study was visually checked as a top-down ground plan. The strict semantic raster retains the complete twelve-sided envelope and all reviewed plan ink within it while removing the overprinted A-A section corridor. Annular masonry and true supports are walls; radial vault traces, font, pulpit and outer outline remain flat source detail.

review: The published 2024 HBIM paper was checked in full from the University of Pisa institutional repository. Figure 6(d) remains the ground-floor source. Its full dodecagonal outline is retained rather than clipped by annotation masks; the source A-A section overprint is removed as annotation, and no obscured plan pixels are reconstructed. Ground-floor annular masonry and true supports are walls, while vault traces, font and pulpit remain flat. The paper links its author-created 3DVista environment at maxmartino.it/battistero; that project's script assigns the map object labelled planimetria_p1 to panoramas labelled battistero_primo. The accepted v2 first-floor layer is unchanged: filled outer masonry and twelve source-drawn support profiles are walls; paired radial arch/vault strokes, railings and lower-level references remain flat detail. No ideal circles, replacement columns, contour fills or annular floor fills are introduced.
limitations: 底层来自2024年HBIM论文图6(d)；上层来自同一论文作者虚拟导览中明确标作首层并绑定至battistero_primo全景的平面图。
首层的径向成对线表示拱或拱顶轨迹，均作平面细节；只有原图填实的外圈砌体与十二个实际支承符号作墙体，不把楼廊切成扇形隔间。
底层完整保留原图十二边形外轮廓；横穿平面的A-A剖切线及其字母属于版面注记，已排除，重叠处不臆补被遮挡线条。
原图的楼廊、中央挑空与图外白底在不补线时属于同一连通域，透明度也只给出外轮廓而没有单独挑空填色；因此不生成环形地板或中央挑空多边形。
论文与馆方文字确认两条互不相交的螺旋梯连接两层，但首层图未画梯级、井道边界或上下落点，故不生成垂直连接定位。
穹顶维护空间另有planimetria_cupola图并绑定至battistero_cupola全景；它不是女性楼廊游客层，本模型不纳入。
两张图均为建筑与导览证据，不是当前开放、无障碍或疏散路线；开放状态仍须现场确认。

rasterLayers.reason: Black pixels are reviewed original source pixels for annular masonry and true support profiles. The A-A section overprint is excluded before classification; no regularized ring or replacement support is emitted.
Gray pixels are original source linework kept flat: the complete dodecagonal envelope, vault traces, railings, font and pulpit. The A-A line and surrounding panel labels are absent.

sourceProjection.basis: The full published figure is retained as a one-page PDF audit copy containing plan, sections and elevations. Only the lower-right overhead ground plan was derived into the primary source; no floor is extracted directly here.

The direct author-published map bitmap is a top-down plan labelled planimetria_p1 in the linked virtual-tour script and is assigned there to battistero_primo panoramas. Equal x/y pixel scale is retained. V2 only recolors reviewed source pixels: outer masonry and actual support marks are wall; radial arch/vault traces and railings are detail.
